name: context-checkpoint
description: Deliberate context compaction for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that reads the live context size from the session transcript and, every N% of the window, after a cold-cache pause, or on a task-boundary prompt, asks the model to decide in one line whether to keep or compact — on relevance and freshness of what is in context, not its size. Ships the hook, a per-machine config, a --status reading, and a skill that explains the criteria and the measurements behind them.
